objective: Test whether a development-only, evidence-gated HistoWeave policy yields non-zero patient-level personalization coverage and lower deployed regret than always-global on a second untouched external study.
claim_boundary: The protocol can test transport to one new seven-patient CRC study and can update a sequential evidence record containing the earlier HER2ST study. It cannot establish universal method superiority, clinical utility, or transport to untested assays and tissues.

required_objects: protocol commit on a public GitHub branch
public GitHub issue containing the protocol commit SHA and protocol SHA-256
public_lock.unlock_rule: Both objects must be independently visible before any CRC count matrix, image, spot label, prediction, score, or derived outcome is downloaded or opened.

external_study.name: Valdeolivas colorectal cancer spatial transcriptomics cohort
external_study.condition: colorectal cancer and one non-neoplastic patient sample
external_study.ground_truth: pathologist-authored spot anatomical-compartment labels distributed by the source study

allowed_before_lock: Zenodo filenames, file sizes, URLs, and checksums

independent_unit.aggregation: Compute ARI per section and seed, average seeds within section, then average the two serial sections within patient. Resampling and policy contrasts use patients only.

data_inclusion.include: All 14 Space Ranger outputs and all corresponding pathologist spot annotations in the locked Zenodo record.
data_inclusion.spot_filter: Use source in-tissue spots with non-zero total counts and a uniquely matched pathologist label. Do not remove difficult or rare pathology categories after seeing method performance.
data_inclusion.replicate_failure: A patient-method score is available when at least one of the two sections and at least one seed succeeds. Availability and all failures remain explicit.
data_inclusion.failed_primary_panel: If any fixed-panel method is available on fewer than five patients, the aligned-panel primary endpoint is evidence_required.

non_oracle_contract.shared_input: raw counts and spatial coordinates from the same included spots
non_oracle_contract.prediction_freeze: All attempts, failures, actions, output paths, and SHA-256 prediction hashes must be frozen before pathology labels are unsealed.

fixed_method_panel.implementation: official STAGATE_pyG upstream locked by commit

development_meta_panel.alignment_requirement: Every included development unit is rerun with the same inputs, methods, K estimator, seed set, failure semantics, and score aggregation used for CRC.
development_meta_panel.minimum_for_policy_training: At least two studies, at least 12 independent units in total, and every method available on at least 10 units.
development_meta_panel.crc_exclusion: No CRC expression, coordinate, image, label, prediction, or score may enter development, feature scaling, policy selection, gate calibration, or global-default selection.

comparators: published SRTBenchmark rule with locked fallback
candidate_models_in_simplicity_order: ridge method-score regression with alpha in [0.1, 1, 10, 100]
policy_search_space.validation: Nested leave-one-study-out. Hyperparameters and robust scaling are fit without the held-out study. Study is never represented in both training and validation folds.
policy_search_space.selection_rule: Choose the simplest model and highest-coverage gate whose nested held-out deployed regret is non-inferior to always-global at margin 0.02 and whose point deployed regret is no higher than always-global. Break remaining ties by lower deployed regret, then fixed model order, then higher gate threshold.
policy_search_space.freeze_before_crc_labels: Freeze development score and feature hashes, fitted policy parameters, development-only global action, and CRC patient actions computed from label-free CRC inputs.

endpoints.unit_regret: best available fixed-panel patient ARI minus policy-selected patient ARI
endpoints.coverage: fraction of evaluable patients on which the policy selects a method different from the development-only global action
endpoints.deployed_risk: mean regret after global fallback on uncovered patients
endpoints.primary_contrast: HistoWeave v4 deployed patient regret minus always-global deployed patient regret
endpoints.confidence_interval: paired percentile bootstrap with 10000 replicates and seed 20260729, resampling patients only
endpoints.noninferiority_success: upper 95 percent bootstrap bound is at most 0.02
endpoints.personalized_value_success: coverage is at least 2/7, point deployed-risk difference is below zero, and the upper 95 percent bootstrap bound is below zero
risk_coverage_outputs: coverage and deployed risk over the locked gate grid
difference from existing rule at common patient availability
difference from published rule at common patient availability
area under the deployed risk-coverage curve

real_positive_scenario.primary: The untouched CRC endpoint itself; success requires the personalized_value_success rule and therefore cannot be manufactured by a synthetic generator.
real_positive_scenario.secondary_construct_check: A retrospective real-unit panel may show that the code can emit personalized actions, but it is not confirmatory efficacy evidence.
real_positive_scenario.corrected_predicate: Coverage is defined only by selecting a non-global action. No success condition may require the global method to appear among covered units.

sensitivity_and_scope.report: Report the paired effect estimate and interval at achieved n. State that seven patients can exclude zero only for a large and consistent advantage and cannot establish universal transport.
sensitivity_and_scope.sequential_external_record: Interpret CRC jointly with the earlier seven-donor prospective HER2ST study as two outcome-sealed studies, while keeping their different locked policy versions explicit.
